steps.name: check-deps
steps.description: Verify t0018_zero_shot_cloning_calibration is completed and confirm its adapters, references and prompt sets are usable.

steps.name: init-folders
steps.description: Create the mandatory task folder structure and seed the aggregator cache.

steps.name: research-papers
steps.description: Review corpus papers on TTS latency optimization: streaming decoding, TensorRT/vLLM inference acceleration, flow-matching vocoders.

steps.name: research-internet
steps.description: Research CosyVoice2 and Chatterbox acceleration paths: load_jit/load_trt, vLLM LLM backend, torch.compile, streaming APIs, chunking strategies.

steps.name: research-code
steps.description: Review t0018's adapters, harness wiring, reference clips and prompt sets in code/ and data/references/ for reuse.

steps.name: planning
steps.description: Design the per-stage latency profiling protocol and the acceleration-variant matrix for both systems, with budget and risk plan.

steps.name: setup-machines
steps.description: Provision LLM-T1-NC80, arm the idle watchdog, and prepare CosyVoice2/Chatterbox environments with TensorRT/vLLM builds.

steps.name: implementation
steps.description: Run per-stage latency profiling and acceleration variants for CosyVoice2 and Chatterbox, plus the S-0018-02 and F5-TTS closure cells.

steps.name: teardown
steps.description: Destroy the remote GPU instance and finalize cost tracking once all variants complete.

steps.name: creative-thinking
steps.description: Consider alternative levers beyond the planned acceleration matrix (e.g. distillation, smaller models) for reaching the 300 ms target.

steps.name: results
steps.description: Write results_summary.md, results_detailed.md, metrics.json, latency_breakdown.json and charts.

steps.name: compare-literature
steps.description: Compare achieved TTFB/speaker_sim figures against published CosyVoice2/Chatterbox/streaming-TTS latency benchmarks.

steps.name: suggestions
steps.description: Write suggestions.json, including a production-integration feasibility task if 300 ms is reached, or a distillation follow-up if not.

steps.name: reporting
steps.description: Final verification pass, session capture, and reporting.
